### Support Unhappy TriggerHappy

Unhappy TriggerHappy is free and open source, designed, built and maintained by one developer in his own time. If it has earned a place on your player, you can support its development:

- GitHub Sponsors: https://github.com/sponsors/foonerd
- Ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/justanerd

Unhappy TriggerHappy is provided as-is under the MIT licence. Sponsorship is a thank-you, not a purchase: it buys no priority, no features and no support agreement.
